metadata.case_name: LEUNG SEE NING CLARA v. SHUN TAK PROPERTY MANAGEMENT LTD

plaintiff.occupation_after: Working in the Department of Justice

source: The Plaintiff was admitted to Queen Mary Hospital where she was found to have fracture of left distal fibula. Open reduction and internal fixation was performed on 21 December 2001 and she was discharged on 29 December 2001. Follow up X-ray showed good alignment of the fracture site. On 26 February 2002 during follow-up examination there was no pain except occasional mild pain at the fracture site. In June 2003 she had another operation to remove the screw and metal plate. She has a scar at the ankle measuring 8½ cm long.
